title: Brand profile onboarding flow (5 required + 4 optional questions)
description: Multi-step onboarding form that captures coach's brand voice. 5 required questions (style_words, tone, emoji_usage, target_audience, sign_off) and 4 optional (avoided_topics, avoided_words, preferred_words, example_posts). Skip flow: allow skipping but prompt again after 3 generations. Saves to brand_profiles table.
close_reason: Onboarding flow already implemented and tested (9 passing tests)

title: Sprint 4: Reminders + Polish + Launch Ready
description: Production-ready MVP with cron reminders, full test coverage, mobile support, and polished error states. Demo: Full journey - login → onboard → chat → framework caption → save draft → plan week → receive reminder email → mark posted → edit settings.
acceptance_criteria: Cron job sends reminder emails for due content. Manual POST trigger works for testing. All lib modules (claude, email) have unit tests. Error boundaries catch and display errors. All pages mobile-responsive at 375px and 768px. Every form button has loading state. No silent failures.

title: Cron reminders route + vercel.json + CRON_SECRET
description: Create src/app/api/cron/reminders/route.ts and vercel.json. GET handler for Vercel Cron (every 30 min). Validates Authorization: Bearer {CRON_SECRET}. Uses createServiceClient (bypasses RLS). Queries content WHERE status='reminder_set' AND reminder_at <= NOW(). Joins coaches table for current email/name. Calls sendPostingReminder for each. Updates status to 'posted'. Individual email failures don't abort batch (log + continue). Returns { processed: N, errors: M }. Also add POST handler with same CRON_SECRET validation for manual trigger during testing/demos. Add CRON_SECRET to .env.example.
acceptance_criteria: GET returns 401 without valid CRON_SECRET. Queries only due reminders. Joins coaches for email. Sends reminder emails. Updates content status. Individual failures don't abort. POST manual trigger works. vercel.json configures 30-min cron. CRON_SECRET documented in .env.example.

title: Unit tests for Claude and email libraries
description: Create src/lib/ai/__tests__/claude.test.ts and src/lib/email/__tests__/resend.test.ts. Claude tests: buildSystemPrompt with null profile, full profile with all attributes, truncated example posts >500 chars. generateContent success, 429 rate limit, 5xx server error, 400 invalid request. Email tests: sendMagicLink correct from/subject, sendPostingReminder HTML escaping of coach name and content, correct content link URL, Resend error handling. Mock @anthropic-ai/sdk and resend packages.
acceptance_criteria: 8+ Claude tests covering all prompt variants and error conditions. 6+ email tests covering both functions and XSS escaping. All mocks use vi.hoisted pattern. All tests pass.

title: Error boundary and ErrorMessage component
description: Create src/app/error.tsx (Next.js error boundary) and src/components/ui/ErrorMessage.tsx. error.tsx: user-friendly message with Try Again button and link to /chat. ErrorMessage: inline component with icon and message text, dismissable. Audit all pages to use try/catch on fetch calls and render ErrorMessage on failure.
acceptance_criteria: error.tsx renders with Try Again reset button and /chat link. ErrorMessage renders inline with icon and message. All pages handle fetch errors with ErrorMessage. No silent failures.

title: Mobile-first responsive: 3 breakpoints (640/1024) + bottom tabs
description: Review and update all pages for 3 responsive breakpoints: Mobile (<640px): bottom tab bar, full-width chat, horizontal scroll refinement buttons, bottom sheet framework picker, input pinned to bottom. Tablet (640-1024px): same as mobile with more padding, centered IG preview (max-w-sm). Desktop (>1024px): left sidebar nav replaces bottom tabs, max-w-2xl chat, 3-column framework picker overlay, 2x2 admin metric grid. All touch targets minimum 44x44px. Verify at 375px (iPhone SE), 640px, 768px (tablet), and 1024px+ (desktop).
acceptance_criteria: Chat input fixed to bottom on mobile. Messages don't overlap input. Nav collapses on mobile. Content cards stack. Modals full-screen on mobile. Settings full-width. Verified at 375px and 768px breakpoints.

title: Loading states and optimistic updates audit
description: Audit all pages and components for missing loading states. Every form submit button must show loading spinner and be disabled during request. Every page data fetch must show skeleton or spinner. Every destructive action (delete) must require confirmation. All error states must be visible and dismissable. No silent failures anywhere in the app.
acceptance_criteria: Every submit button has spinner + disabled state during request. Every page load shows skeleton/spinner. Delete actions require confirmation. All error states visible. No silent failures on any user action.

title: Founder admin dashboard page
description: Create src/app/admin/page.tsx. Protected route — only visible to founder account (check against ADMIN_EMAIL env var). Shows: 4 metric cards (active coaches count, generations today, error rate %, avg generation latency ms), Claude API cost tracking (tokens used today, estimated cost), learning loop metrics (copy rate, edit rate per coach), activity list (recent generations with coach name, framework, timestamp), cron health indicator (last_cron_run timestamp with yellow warning if >5min stale). Loading: skeleton cards. Empty: 'No data yet. Invite your first coaches.' Simple, no charts for 10 coaches — just big numbers + activity list.

title: Health check endpoint + cron monitoring
description: Create src/app/api/health/route.ts. GET returns { status: 'ok', timestamp, version }. No auth required. Update cron reminders route (juno-ch1.1): write last_cron_run timestamp to a system_health table on each execution. Admin dashboard reads this to show cron health. Add system_health table to Supabase: key (varchar), value (jsonb), updated_at. Cron writes { key: 'last_cron_run', value: { timestamp, processed, errors } }. UptimeRobot or similar can ping /api/health for uptime monitoring.

title: Sprint 3: Content Library + Settings + Batch UI
description: Coach can view all content, plan a full week, and edit brand voice. Demo: Content library → Plan My Week → 5 posts with progress → copy one → update brand voice in settings.
acceptance_criteria: Content library page renders with filter tabs (All/Draft/Reminder/Posted). BatchModal shows Generating X of N progress. ReminderModal converts local time to UTC. Settings page loads and saves brand profile. Framework picker integrated into chat page.

title: ContentCard component
description: Create src/components/content/ContentCard.tsx. Shows body preview (150 chars + ...), status badge (draft=gray, reminder_set=blue, posted=green), moderation rating colored dot, relative created date. Actions: Copy (full body), Set Reminder, Mark Posted (only if not posted), Delete with confirmation dialog.
acceptance_criteria: Body truncated at 150 chars. Status badge shows correct color. Moderation dot displays. Copy copies full body. Delete requires confirmation. Mark Posted only shown for non-posted content.

title: ReminderModal component
description: Create src/components/content/ReminderModal.tsx. Modal overlay with date+time input (min=now). Converts coach's local time to UTC using coaches.timezone before saving. Submit calls PATCH /api/content/[id] with { reminder_at (UTC), status: 'reminder_set' }. Success closes modal and calls onSuccess(). Error shows inline message. Cancel closes without changes.
acceptance_criteria: Date/time input has min=now constraint. Local time correctly converted to UTC. Submit calls PATCH with UTC reminder_at. Success closes modal. Error displayed inline. Cancel closes cleanly.

title: BatchModal: vertical timeline with day labels and content type badges
description: Create src/components/content/BatchModal.tsx. Step 1: input focus topic (required). Step 2: day checkboxes Mon-Sun (at least 1 required). Step 3: promotion toggle + optional text input. Step 4: loading with 'Creating post X of N...' progress indicator. Step 5: results displayed as vertical timeline with day labels (Mon/Wed/Fri) and content type badges (Educational, Client Win, Engagement, etc). Each post is a collapsible card in the timeline showing: content preview, copy button, save draft button. Partial failures show successful posts + retry button for failed ones. Close button throughout. Calls POST /api/content/batch.
acceptance_criteria: All 3 input steps work with validation. Loading state shows Generating X of N progress. Success shows all posts with copy buttons. Error state offers retry. Modal closeable at any step.

title: Drafts page at /drafts (content management)
description: Create src/app/drafts/page.tsx (NOT /content). Fetches content via GET /api/content. Loading: skeleton cards. Empty state: illustration + 'No drafts yet. Start creating\!' with CTA button linking to /chat. Renders ContentCard list. Filter tabs: All / Draft / Reminder Set / Posted. Header: 'Plan My Week' button opens BatchModal. State updates when card actions complete (mark posted, delete, set reminder). Tab name in bottom nav is 'Drafts'. LIMIT 100 on query.
acceptance_criteria: Content loads with skeleton state. Empty state renders correctly. Filter tabs work. Card actions update list state. New Content links to /chat. Plan My Week opens BatchModal. LIMIT 100 on query.

title: Settings page for brand profile editing
description: Create src/app/settings/page.tsx. Brand profile editing only (no coach name/timezone in MVP). Loads via GET /api/profile. Form fields for: style_words, tone (select), emoji_usage (select), sign_off, target_audience, preferred_words, avoided_words, avoided_topics, example_posts. Save calls PATCH /api/profile. Success message 'Brand voice updated\!'. Link back to /chat.
acceptance_criteria: Loads existing profile data into form. All 9 fields editable. Tone and emoji_usage are select dropdowns. Save calls PATCH with correct payload. Success toast displays. Error state on failure. Back to chat link works.

title: Quick actions bar + framework/batch integration in chat
description: Modify src/app/chat/page.tsx. Quick actions bar above chat input with pill-shaped buttons: [What to post today?] [Plan My Week] [+New Content]. Tapping '+New Content' opens FrameworkPicker as bottom sheet. Selecting a framework opens FrameworkForm. Completing form calls buildFrameworkPrompt and pre-fills constructed prompt into chat input. 'Plan My Week' opens BatchModal. 'What to post today?' triggers suggestion logic (picks framework + topic based on what coach hasn't posted recently). User can edit pre-filled prompt before sending. Cancel collapses bottom sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Use Framework button visible above chat input. Picker opens correctly. Form completion pre-fills chat input with constructed prompt. User can edit before sending. Cancel works. Normal chat flow continues after framework prompt sent.

title: Tests for batch route edge cases
description: Create/extend tests for /api/content/batch covering: partial failure (one Claude call fails, others succeed, batch status='partial'), timeout handling, empty results, rate limit hit mid-batch. Follow existing vi.hoisted + vi.mock pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Partial failure test: batch continues after one error, returns successful posts, status='partial'. Timeout test: batch respects maxDuration. Empty results handled gracefully. All tests pass.

title: Instagram mockup preview component
description: Create src/components/content/IGPreview.tsx. Renders generated content in a pixel-accurate Instagram post frame: profile pic circle (coach avatar or green 'J' default), username, caption text (truncated at ~300 chars with '...more' like real IG), like/comment/share/save icon row, hashtags in lighter gray below caption. Props: caption, coachName, coachAvatar?, hashtags?. Long captions show truncated with expand toggle. Responsive: full-width on mobile, max-w-sm on tablet/desktop. Used as an inline card in chat messages when content is generated.

title: Quick refinement buttons + hashtag toggle UI
description: Create src/components/content/ContentOutput.tsx. Appears below IG preview in chat when content is generated. Contains: 1) Format tabs: [Caption] [Carousel] [Reel] — switches displayed format (role='tablist', arrow key navigation). 2) Refinement toolbar: [Shorter] [Longer] [Casual] [Professional] [Spicy] — pill-shaped buttons, horizontal scroll on mobile (role='toolbar'). Tapping a refinement button calls /api/chat with 'Make this [shorter/longer/etc]' + current content. Shows shimmer loading, then replaces content smoothly. 3) HashtagPicker: toggle chips below content. Auto-suggested by Claude, coach toggles on/off (role='checkbox', aria-checked). 4) Action buttons: [Copy] [Save Draft] [Set Reminder]. Copy includes enabled hashtags. All buttons have aria-labels.

title: Auth flow: magic link login page and auth callback
close_reason: Auth flow already implemented and tested (10 passing tests)

title: Sprint 1: Foundation UI + Working Chat
description: A logged-in coach can chat with Juno and get AI-generated responses. Demo: Login → onboarding → chat → AI response → copy to clipboard.
acceptance_criteria: Coach can login, complete onboarding, open /chat, send a message, receive AI response, and copy it to clipboard. All protected routes redirect properly. 27+ existing tests still pass plus new tests for chat API and UI components.

title: UI primitives: Button, Input, Textarea, LoadingSpinner, CopyButton
description: Create reusable UI components in src/components/ui/. Button: variants (primary/secondary/ghost), loading spinner, disabled state. Input: label, error slot, focus ring. Textarea: auto-resize, same styling as Input. LoadingSpinner: animated SVG, size prop (sm/md/lg). CopyButton: writes to clipboard, shows Copied! for 2s, graceful fallback. All use Tailwind with green-600 primary matching existing design language.
acceptance_criteria: All variants render correctly. CopyButton copies to clipboard and shows Copied! for 2s. LoadingSpinner animates. Components match existing Tailwind patterns (green-600 primary, border-gray-300, rounded-lg).

title: AppShell layout: bottom tab bar (mobile) + sidebar (desktop)
description: Create src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx. Mobile (<640px): bottom tab bar with 3 tabs (Chat, Drafts, Settings) pinned to bottom. Icons + labels. Active tab highlighted with green-600. Desktop (>1024px): left sidebar with same 3 tabs as vertical list, logo at top, sign-out at bottom. Sign-out calls supabase.auth.signOut() and redirects to /auth/login. Admin tab only visible for founder account (check env var or role). Chat is the default/home tab. No top nav bar. Used by /chat, /drafts, /settings pages.
acceptance_criteria: Nav renders with all links. Sign-out works and redirects. Active link highlighted. Wraps child content correctly.

title: Environment variable validation module
description: Create src/lib/env.ts that validates required env vars at import time: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL. Throws descriptive error if any are missing. Replaces process.env.X! non-null assertions in claude.ts and resend.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Missing env var throws clear error message at startup. All required vars validated. Existing modules updated to import from env.ts.

title: Routing wiring: middleware protected routes + home page redirect
description: Update src/middleware.ts and src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts: Add /drafts to protectedRoutes array. Unauthenticated requests to /chat, /drafts, /settings, /admin redirect to /auth/login. Authenticated users without completed onboarding redirect to /onboarding (unless skipped_count > 0). /api/* routes return 401 JSON not redirect. Update src/app/page.tsx: authenticated users → /chat, unauthenticated → /auth/login. /admin route additionally checks ADMIN_EMAIL env var.
acceptance_criteria: All protected routes redirect unauthenticated users. Onboarding gate works correctly. Home page redirects based on auth state. API routes return 401 JSON.

title: /api/chat POST route handler
description: Create src/app/api/chat/route.ts. POST handler: authenticate user, load brand profile, load last 20 chat messages for history (ordered ASC), call generateContent with history, persist user + assistant messages to chat_messages table, detect content in response and optionally save to content table as draft. Return { message, contentId? }. Validate message: required, max 2000 chars. Return 401/400/500 appropriately. Include rate limiting (apply lib/rateLimit.ts if built, otherwise inline check).
acceptance_criteria: Returns 401 without auth. Returns 400 for empty/oversized message. Loads last 20 messages for context. Calls generateContent with brand profile and history. Persists both messages. Returns { message, contentId? }. Handles Claude API errors gracefully.

title: Chat page: iMessage-style UI with quick actions bar
description: Create src/app/chat/page.tsx, src/components/chat/MessageBubble.tsx, src/components/chat/ChatInput.tsx, src/components/chat/QuickActions.tsx. Chat page: loads message history on mount, renders message list in iMessage/WhatsApp style. MessageBubble: coach messages right-aligned (green-50 bg, green-200 border, rounded-2xl), Juno messages left-aligned (gray-100 bg, gray-200 border) with green 'J' avatar. Content output appears as inline cards in conversation (IG preview, format tabs, etc). ChatInput: Textarea pinned to bottom, Enter=send, Shift+Enter=newline, disabled during loading. QuickActions: pill-shaped buttons above input — [What to post today?] [Plan My Week] [+New Content]. Primary delivery: direct HTTP response from /api/chat (NOT Realtime). Supabase Realtime subscription optional for multi-tab sync only. Optimistic UI: append coach message immediately, show animated dots for Juno, append response on completion, auto-scroll. Copy button on Juno messages. Save Draft button if content generated.
acceptance_criteria: Chat history loads on page mount. Messages display correctly (user right, assistant left). Enter sends message, Shift+Enter adds newline. Optimistic UI shows user message immediately. Loading state visible during API call. Assistant response appears and auto-scrolls. Copy button works on assistant messages. API errors show inline error message.

title: Composable prompts.ts module with anti-slop + injection protection
description: Create src/lib/ai/prompts.ts. Extract prompt building from claude.ts into composable segments: buildVoiceSegment(profile) wraps user-provided brand profile fields in <coach_data> XML tags to prevent prompt injection. buildAntiSlopSegment() returns banned AI phrases and required authenticity markers. buildFrameworkSegment(framework, answers) injects framework template. buildFormatSegment(formats) adds multi-format instructions. buildSystemPrompt(options) composes all segments. Fix BrandProfile type: use Pick<> from database.ts. Include unit tests for each segment.

title: Onboarding wow moment: auto-generate sample post after brand profile
description: Extend src/app/onboarding/page.tsx. After coach completes brand profile (handleFinish), instead of redirecting straight to /chat: show a loading state ('Let me show you something...'), call /api/chat with a sample prompt like 'Write a short Instagram post that shows off my coaching style', display the result in an IG mockup preview component, ask 'Sound like you?' with [Yes, let's go\!] and [Not quite - let me update my profile] buttons. This is the trust inflection point — if the sample sounds like the coach, retention is established. On 'Yes': redirect to /chat. On 'Not quite': go back to brand profile editing.

title: Sprint 2: Content API + Framework System
description: Framework-guided content generation with moderation and batch support. Demo: Pick Client Win Story framework → fill questions → caption generated → content saved → retrievable via API.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 frameworks render and generate content. Moderation classifies content as Green/Yellow/Red. Batch generation creates 1-7 posts sequentially with partial failure recovery. Rate limiting enforced on expensive endpoints. All new API routes have unit tests.

title: Rate limiter utility
description: Create src/lib/rateLimit.ts. In-memory rate limiter using Map + timestamp. 10 requests/minute per user.id. Returns { allowed: boolean, retryAfterMs: number }. Apply to /api/chat and /api/content/batch routes. Sliding window approach.
acceptance_criteria: Allows 10 requests within 1 minute window. Denies 11th request with retryAfterMs. Window resets after 60s. Different users have independent limits.

title: FrameworkForm step-by-step component
description: Create src/components/frameworks/FrameworkForm.tsx. Renders questions one per step matching the onboarding wizard pattern (progress bar, Back/Next buttons). Text questions use Input component. Select questions use button grid. Validates required answers before allowing Next. Calls onSubmit(answers) on final step. Calls onCancel() to go back to picker.
acceptance_criteria: Step navigation works (Back/Next). Progress bar shows current step. Required fields validated before Next. Select inputs work correctly. Final step calls onSubmit with all answers. Cancel returns to picker.

title: Tests for all Sprint 2 API routes and utilities
description: Create tests following existing vi.hoisted + vi.mock pattern: src/app/api/chat/__tests__/route.test.ts, src/app/api/content/__tests__/route.test.ts, src/app/api/content/[id]/__tests__/route.test.ts, src/app/api/frameworks/__tests__/route.test.ts, src/app/api/content/batch/__tests__/route.test.ts, src/lib/__tests__/moderation.test.ts, src/lib/__tests__/frameworks.test.ts. Cover: auth failures, validation errors, successful operations, edge cases, moderation classifications, framework prompt building.
acceptance_criteria: All new API routes have test coverage. Moderation utility tests cover green/yellow/red categories. Framework utility tests cover all 5 templates. Tests follow existing vi.hoisted + vi.mock pattern. All tests pass.

title: Multi-format content output (caption + carousel + reel)
description: Extend content generation to produce 3 formats in a single Claude API call for individual posts: caption (single image text), carousel script (8 slides), reel script (30-sec talking points). Use XML tags (<caption>, <carousel>, <reel>) in prompt to structure output. Create parseMultiFormatResponse(text) in src/lib/ai/claude.ts that extracts available formats. Handle partial responses gracefully (if only 1-2 formats parse, return those with warning). For batch generation: only generate primary format (caption) per post, with option to expand per-post later. Store all formats in content.body as JSON { caption, carousel?, reel? }.

title: Content interactions tracking (learning loop)
description: Create content_interactions table in Supabase: id, coach_id, content_id, event_type (generated/viewed/copied/edited/confirmed/skipped), metadata (JSON - framework_id, format_copied, etc), created_at. Add trackContentEvent() utility in src/lib/tracking.ts. Call it from: /api/chat (generated), CopyButton (copied), refinement actions (edited), 'I posted it' (confirmed), skip (skipped). Track silently — never block UX on tracking failure. This data feeds the 'What should I post today?' suggestion logic and founder admin metrics.

title: Structured logging + Claude API token/cost tracking
description: Add structured logging to all API routes: { event, coach_id, framework, latency_ms, token_usage, timestamp }. For Claude API calls specifically: extract input_tokens and output_tokens from response.usage and store in a usage_logs table (or append to content_interactions with event_type='generation'). Track per-generation: model used, tokens in/out, estimated cost. Aggregate daily for founder admin page. Use console.log with JSON format for Vercel log ingestion.

title: 'What should I post today?' suggestion logic
description: Create src/lib/suggestions.ts. suggestContent(coachId) returns a framework + topic suggestion based on: 1) Which frameworks the coach hasn't used this week (from content_interactions). 2) Which content types are underrepresented. 3) Coach's brand profile topics. Algorithm: query recent content (last 7 days), find least-used framework, generate a topic from brand profile focus areas. Returns { framework, suggestedTopic, reason }. Used by the 'What to post today?' quick action button in chat.

title: Content moderation utility
description: Create src/lib/moderation.ts. Pure function moderateContent(text): { rating: 'green'|'yellow'|'red', reasons: string[] }. Red: hardcoded blocklist (medical claims, illegal activity phrases). Yellow: content <50 chars, >2200 chars, hedging phrases. Green: everything else. Empty string → yellow. Tests in same file or adjacent test file covering each rating category, boundary lengths, multiple triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Red blocklist words return red with reasons. Clean content returns green. Short/long content returns yellow. Empty string returns yellow. Multiple triggers accumulate reasons. Unit tests cover all categories.

title: Framework utility functions
description: Create src/lib/frameworks.ts. buildFrameworkPrompt(framework, answers): replaces {key} placeholders in prompt_template with answer values. Returns error if placeholder has no matching answer. validateFrameworkAnswers(framework, answers): checks all required question keys present and non-empty, returns field-level errors. Tests cover all 5 framework templates from DB seed data.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 framework prompt templates resolve correctly. Missing answer returns error. Extra answers ignored. validateFrameworkAnswers returns field-level errors for missing required fields.

title: Supabase service role client
description: Create src/lib/supabase/service.ts. createServiceClient() uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY for server-only operations bypassing RLS (cron, admin). Throws clearly if env var missing. Must never be imported in client components.
acceptance_criteria: Service client creates successfully with valid env. Throws descriptive error if SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY missing. Exported for server-only use.

title: /api/content GET + POST routes
description: Create src/app/api/content/route.ts. GET: list coach's content ordered by created_at DESC, optional ?status= filter, LIMIT 100. POST: Zod validation for { type, body } with body max 3000 chars, run moderateContent, save to content table, return record with moderation_rating. Follow existing profile route pattern (auth check, Zod, NextResponse.json).
acceptance_criteria: GET returns array ordered newest-first. GET ?status=draft filters correctly. POST validates type and body. POST enforces body max 3000 chars. POST runs moderation and includes rating in response. 401 without auth. 400 on invalid input.

title: /api/content/[id] GET + PATCH + DELETE routes
description: Create src/app/api/content/[id]/route.ts. GET: single content item or 404. PATCH: validate { body?, status?, reminder_at? } with Zod, status must be draft|reminder_set|posted. DELETE: hard delete (RLS enforces ownership). All routes return 404 for other coach's content (RLS returns empty result).
acceptance_criteria: GET returns item or 404. PATCH updates body, status, reminder_at with validation. Status restricted to valid enum. DELETE removes record. 404 for non-existent or other coach's content.

title: /api/frameworks GET route
description: Create src/app/api/frameworks/route.ts. GET: fetch all active frameworks from content_frameworks table ordered by display_order. Return array with id, name, description, output_type, questions. No auth required (frameworks are static data).
acceptance_criteria: Returns all 5 seeded frameworks. Correct ordering by display_order. Each framework includes questions array. No auth required.
close_reason: Frameworks are hardcoded TypeScript constants per eng review decision. No API route needed.

title: /api/content/batch route
description: Create src/app/api/content/batch/route.ts. Validate { focus_topic: string, posting_days: string[] (min 1, max 7), promotion_text?: string }. Create content_batches record with status: 'generating'. Sequential Claude calls with 500ms delay between each. For each posting day: select framework or free-form, call generateContent with brand profile, run moderation, insert content row with batch_id and batch_position. On completion: update batch status to 'ready' (or 'partial' if some failed). Individual failures don't abort the batch. Set export const maxDuration = 60. Apply rate limiting.
acceptance_criteria: Validates input schema. posting_days max 7 enforced. Creates batch record. Generates one post per day sequentially. 500ms delay between calls. Partial failure continues with remaining posts. Batch status reflects partial vs full completion. Returns { batchId, content: ContentItem[] }. Rate limited.

title: FrameworkPicker: bottom sheet with hardcoded framework constants
description: Create src/components/frameworks/FrameworkPicker.tsx. Renders as a bottom sheet overlay (slide-up from bottom, mobile-native pattern). Reads 5 framework definitions from hardcoded TypeScript constants in src/lib/frameworks.ts (NOT from /api/frameworks — no API call). Each framework shows: emoji icon, name, one-line description, example output type badge. Plus a 'Freeform' option (6th entry). Tapping calls onSelect(framework). Bottom sheet has drag handle, backdrop overlay, close on swipe-down or backdrop tap. On desktop >1024px: renders as centered modal instead of bottom sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Renders all 5 frameworks plus free-form. Each card shows name, description, output type. Click calls onSelect. Loading spinner during fetch. Error message on fetch failure.
